name: Kawaii Hitozuma no Ureta ○○○ ni 13 Renpatsu!
original_name: かわいい人妻の熟れた○○○に13連発!
source:
A man confesses his love to another man's loli-faced wife but she rejects him. To get back at her after her rejection he teams up with his friends to assault her.
